newsitem.title: UK: Eurobonds - Diary of forthcoming roadshows.
newsitem.headline: Eurobonds - Diary of forthcoming roadshows.

text.p: The following is a list of forthcoming Eurobond roadshows, compiled by Reuters, based on information received by bankers and borrowers. If you would like to contribute to this list please call Denise Manning on +44 171
A two-part 144a $380 million deal via Citibank and Goldman Sachs International.
Mexico's wiring cable producer is planing a Euro/144a issue
COMPANIA DE INVERSIONES EN TELECOMMUNICACIONES SA (COINTEL)
A dollar bond is expected, via joint lead managers Goldman
Sachs International and Merrill Lynch. No further details
A bond for around $150 million with a maturity of up to 10 years is expected to be launched in late July by BankBoston.
A U.S. dollar 144a issue expected via Goldman Sachs and Merrill Lynch. No further details available.
A $100 million five-year FRN is expected to be launched in the first week of August, via HSBC Markets. Unofficial price talk is 150 b.p. over LIBOR.
A 12-year issue for $100 million is expected, via ING Barings.
HSBC and Merrill Lynch have a mandate for a debut sterling transaction from India's largest private sector company.
